cross_references.note: §1094.5(b) fair trial ground tracks whether the APA hearing procedures (GOV §11513) were followed. A §11513 violation — denial of cross-examination, oath-less evidence, hearsay as sole basis — is the predicate for a §1094.5(b) fair trial challenge.
GOV §11340 APA purpose defines the framework within which §1094.5 review operates. The 'manner required by law' in §1094.5(b) refers to the APA framework that GOV §11340 et seq. establishes.

CalVCB appeal A25-10117946: §1094.5 writ of mandate is the vehicle for judicial review of CalVCB's final denial. The 13 FAIL findings from the audit map to §1094.5(b) manner (shortened deadlines), decision-findings link (single-source denial), and fair trial grounds.

GOV §11350 challenges the validity of regulations; CCP §1094.5 challenges the application of regulations in a specific adjudication. They are distinct vehicles: §11350 = rulemaking validity; §1094.5 = adjudicative decision validity.

If Dr. Wiita's PC §1368 evaluation resulted in an OAH adjudication, §1094.5 is the judicial review vehicle. Fair trial ground: was the hearing conducted under GOV §11513 oath/cross-examination requirements? Was the MC-350 absence addressed in the record?
